Monsanto Co New (MON) Holding Lifted by Cheyne Capital Management Uk Llp; Cintas (CTAS) Position Boosted by Bnp Paribas Investment Partners Sa
May 30, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Jonathan Lourie increased its stake in Monsanto Co New (MON) by 2.13% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cheyne Capital Management Uk Llp bought 5,600 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.93% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Jonathan Lourie held 268,817 shares of the agricultural chemicals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $31.37 million, up from 263,217 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cheyne Capital Management Uk Llp who had been investing in Monsanto Co New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $56.26 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.07% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $127.5. About 5.79M shares traded or 45.50% up from the average. Monsanto Company (NYSE:MON) has risen 8.56% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.01% the S&P500.
Bnp Paribas Investment Partners Sa increased its stake in Cintas Corp (CTAS) by 66.16% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bnp Paribas Investment Partners Sa bought 15,889 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.88% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 39,906 shares of the apparel company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.81M, up from 24,017 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bnp Paribas Investment Partners Sa who had been investing in Cintas Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $19.49 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.09% or $1.96 during the last trading session, reaching $182.58. About 156,831 shares traded. Cintas Corporation (NASDAQ:CTAS) has risen 44.04% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 31.47% the S&P500.
Bnp Paribas Investment Partners Sa, which manages about $11.87B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 100,811 shares to 1.41 million shares, valued at $236.01 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Enel Americas S A (NYSE:ENI) by 52,552 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 119,998 shares, and cut its stake in Vipshop Hldgs Ltd (Prn).
